adaptation: Original wording reflowed for DS; POKE tokens expanded; player and saved rival names substituted dynamically. Starter choice chronology follows the requested three-starter variant.

messages._OaksLabRivalGrampsIsntAroundText: {RIVAL}: Yo {PLAYER}! Gramps isn't around!I ran here 'cos he said he had a POKEMON for me.
messages._OaksLabRivalIllGetABetterPokemonThanYou: {RIVAL}: Humph! I'll get a better POKEMON than you!
messages._OaksLabRivalMyPokemonLooksStrongerText: {RIVAL}: Heh, my POKEMON looks a lot stronger.
messages._OaksLabThatsAPokeball: That's a POKE BALL. There's a POKEMON inside!
messages._OaksLabOak1YourPokemonCanFightText: OAK: If a wild POKEMON appears, your POKEMON can fight against it!Afterward, go on to the next town.
messages._OaksLabOak1YouShouldTalkToIt: OAK: You should talk to it and see how it feels.
messages._OaksLabOak1DeliverParcelText: OAK: Oh, {PLAYER}!How is my old POKEMON?Well, it seems to like you a lot.You must be talented as a POKEMON trainer!What? You have something for me?{PLAYER} delivered OAK's PARCEL.
messages._OaksLabOak1ParcelThanksText: Ah! This is the custom POKE BALL I ordered! Thanks, {PLAYER}!By the way, I must ask you to do something for me.
messages._OaksLabOak1PokemonAroundTheWorldText: POKEMON around the world wait for you, {PLAYER}!
messages._OaksLabOak1ReceivedPokeballsText: OAK: You can't get detailed data on POKEMON by just seeing them.You must catch them! Use these to capture wild POKEMON.{PLAYER} got 5 POKE BALLs!
messages._OaksLabGivePokeballsExplanationText: When a wild POKEMON appears, it's fair game.Just like I showed you, throw a POKE BALL at it and try to catch it!This won't always work, though.A healthy POKEMON could escape. You have to be lucky!
messages._OaksLabOak1ComeSeeMeSometimesText: OAK: Come see me sometimes.I want to know how your POKEDEX is coming along.
messages._OaksLabOak1HowIsYourPokedexComingText: OAK: Good to see you! How is your POKEDEX coming? Here, let me take a look!
messages._OaksLabPokedexText: It's encyclopedia- like, but the pages are blank!
messages._OaksLabGirlText: PROF.OAK is the authority on POKEMON!Many POKEMON trainers hold him in high regard!
messages._OaksLabRivalFedUpWithWaitingText: {RIVAL}: Gramps! I'm fed up with waiting!
messages._OaksLabOakChooseMonText: OAK: Hmm? {RIVAL}? Why are you here already?I said for you to come by later...Ah, whatever! Just wait there.Look, {PLAYER}! Do you see that ball on the table?It's called a POKE BALL. It holds a POKEMON inside.You may have it! Go on, take it!
messages._OaksLabOakBePatientText: OAK: Be patient, {RIVAL}, I'll give you one later.
messages._OaksLabRivalTakesText1: {RIVAL}: No way! {PLAYER}, I want this POKEMON!
messages._OaksLabRivalTakesText5: OAK: But, I... Oh, all right then. That POKEMON is yours.I was going to give you one anyway...{PLAYER}, come over here.
messages._OaksLabOakGivesText: OAK: {PLAYER}, this is the POKEMON I caught earlier.You can have it. I caught it in the wild and it's not tame yet.
messages._OaksLabOakDontGoAwayYetText: OAK: Hey! Don't go away yet!
messages._OaksLabRivalIllTakeYouOnText: {RIVAL}: Wait {PLAYER}! Let's check out our POKEMON!Come on, I'll take you on!
messages._OaksLabRivalIPickedTheWrongPokemonText: WHAT? Unbelievable! I picked the wrong POKEMON!
messages._OaksLabRivalAmIGreatOrWhatText: {RIVAL}: Yeah! Am I great or what?
messages._OaksLabRivalSmellYouLaterText: {RIVAL}: Okay! I'll make my POKEMON fight to toughen it up!{PLAYER}! Gramps! Smell you later!
messages._OaksLabPikachuDislikesPokeballsText2: OAK: Would you look at that!It's odd, but it appears that your PIKACHU dislikes POKE BALLs.You should just keep it with you.That should make it happy!You can talk to it and see how it feels about you.
messages._OaksLabRivalMyPokemonHasGrownStrongerTe: {RIVAL}: Gramps, my POKEMON has grown stronger! Check it out!
messages._OaksLabOakIHaveARequestText: OAK: Ah, {RIVAL}, good timing!I needed to ask both of you to do something for me.
messages._OaksLabOakMyInventionPokedexText: On the desk there is my invention, POKEDEX!It automatically records data on POKEMON you've seen or caught!It's a hi-tech encyclopedia!
messages._OaksLabOakGotPokedexText: OAK: {PLAYER} and {RIVAL}! Take these with you!{PLAYER} got POKEDEX from OAK!
messages._OaksLabOakThatWasMyDreamText: To make a complete guide on all the POKEMON in the world...That was my dream!But, I'm too old! I can't do it!So, I want you two to fulfill my dream for me!Get moving, you two!This is a great undertaking in POKEMON history!
messages._OaksLabRivalLeaveItAllToMeText: {RIVAL}: Alright Gramps! Leave it all to me!{PLAYER}, I hate to say it, but I don't need you!I know! I'll borrow a TOWN MAP from my sis!I'll tell her not to lend you one, {PLAYER}! Hahaha!
messages._OaksLabScientistText: I study POKEMON as PROF.OAK's AIDE.
messages._PalletTownOakHeyWaitDontGoOutText: OAK: Hey! Wait! Don't go out!
messages._PalletTownOakThatWasCloseText: OAK: That was close!Wild POKEMON live in tall grass!
messages._PalletTownOakComeWithMe: OAK: A POKEMON can appear anytime in tall grass.You need your own POKEMON for your protection. I know!Here, come with me!
messages._PalletTownGirlText: I'm raising POKEMON too!When they get strong, they can protect me!
messages._PalletTownFisherText: Technology is incredible!You can now store and recall items and POKEMON as data via PC!
messages._PalletTownSignText: PALLET TOWN Shades of your journey await!
messages._Route1Youngster1MartSampleText: Hi! I work at a POKEMON MART.It's a convenient shop, so please visit us in VIRIDIAN CITY.I know, I'll give you a sample! Here you go!
messages._Route1Youngster1AlsoGotPokeballsText: We also carry POKE BALLs for catching POKEMON!
messages._Route1Youngster1NoRoomText: You have too much stuff with you!
messages._Route1Youngster2Text: See those ledges along the road?It's a bit scary, but you can jump from them.You can get back to PALLET TOWN quicker that way.
